name: Ocean
description: The vast open sea—deep, mysterious, and dangerous. Crashing waves, salt spray, and the infinite horizon characterize this biome. Home to maritime trade routes, leviathans, and the unknowable depths.

name: Coastal Shallows
description: Where the ocean meets the land—shallow waters, sandbars, and rocky outcrops. Seagulls cry overhead, and the sound of waves breaking on shore is ever-present.

name: Lake
description: A body of freshwater surrounded by land. Lakes provide sustenance, beauty, and mystery. Some are serene and clear; others are murky and deep, harboring secrets.

name: River
description: Flowing freshwater that carves through the land. Rivers are highways of commerce, sources of life, and often form natural barriers or meeting places.

name: Grassland & Plains
description: Rolling or flat expanses of grass and low vegetation. The horizon stretches endlessly, wind whispers through the grasses, and the sky dominates the landscape. Perfect for cavalry and nomadic peoples.

name: Farmland
description: Cultivated land bearing crops and domesticated life. Plowed fields, irrigation channels, and scattered farmsteads mark human presence. A place of order imposed upon nature.

name: Savanna
description: Grassland with scattered trees, often in warm regions. The dry season browns the grasses; the wet season brings explosive growth. Large herds of grazing animals roam here.

name: Steppe
description: Semi-arid grassland with extreme temperature swings. Sparse vegetation, strong winds, and vast horizons define this hardy biome. Home to nomadic herders and tough peoples.

name: Deciduous Forest
description: A forest of broad-leafed trees that lose their leaves seasonally. Rich undergrowth, dappled light, and the songs of countless birds characterize this temperate biome.

name: Dense Forest
description: A thick, primordial forest with towering trees and dense canopy. Sunlight barely penetrates the gloom; the air is thick with moisture and life. Home to ancient creatures and hidden peoples.

name: Taiga & Boreal Forest
description: The northernmost forest, dominated by coniferous trees like spruce and pine. Long, harsh winters and brief summers define this biome. Solitude and resilience are its hallmarks.

name: Jungle & Tropical Forest
description: A riotous explosion of life in hot, wet lands. Towering canopy, violent competition, and year-round growth create a green chaos. Danger and wonder lurk behind every frond.

name: Swamp & Marsh
description: Waterlogged terrain where water and land blur together. Cattails, lily pads, and murky channels characterize this biome. Insects swarm; the air reeks of decay and life.

name: Bog & Fen
description: A cold, waterlogged biome where sphagnum moss dominates. Sparse vegetation, dark water, and a sense of desolation pervade. Strange lights dance over the water at night.

name: Hills
description: Gently rolling terrain with moderate elevation changes. Valleys nestle between slopes; forests cling to hillsides. A biome of transition and layered views.

name: Mountains
description: Towering peaks that pierce the sky. Snow caps summits, thin air makes breathing difficult, and views stretch for a hundred miles. Home to hermits, dwarves, and ancient dragons.

name: Plateau
description: Elevated terrain with relatively flat expanses at high elevation. Dramatic cliffs drop away; the wind is relentless. A place of stark beauty and exposed geology.

name: Badlands
description: A landscape of eroded ridges, gullies, and colorful stratified rock. Little vegetation survives here; heat shimmers off the stone. An alien, austere beauty pervades.

name: Desert
description: Vast, arid expanses of sand or stone where water is precious. Extreme heat by day, freezing cold by night. Oases are treasured; trade routes cut across the dunes.

name: Tundra
description: Frozen wasteland where permafrost underlies sparse, hardy vegetation. Brutal cold defines this biome. Few humans survive here; those who do are tough beyond measure.

name: Glacier & Ice
description: Vast sheets of ancient ice covering land and sea. Crevasses hide deadly falls; the ice creaks and groans as it moves. A place of stark beauty and existential cold.

name: Volcanic
description: Landscapes shaped by volcanic activity. Lava flows, ash fields, and hot springs dot the terrain. The earth rumbles with primal power; danger and opportunity intertwine.
